changes: Original DocumentsView/DocumentOptions/DocumentViewer/DocumentsScrollbar/DocumentEditor/Footer/toggle/dropdown/button retained and actually rendered. Original Markdown helpers retained through safe wrapper.

Only DocumentsView render editMode gates additionally on !running, preventing pre-existing Edit mode from staying writable during simulated streaming. State bridge also refuses stale edit callbacks during running.
Actual useResearch/useCopilotChat replaced by explicitly local in-memory context, not backend/model simulation success. A manual button supplies a clearly labeled streaming fixture.
Markdown HTML skipped, image/media embeds disallowed, links rendered as text with title; arbitrary edited Markdown cannot fetch media or navigate externally.
Original CSS/Tailwind theme compiled with actual locked local tool versions; no Next/font or Noto/Lato binary assets loaded, original serif/sans fallback retained.
React18.3.1 instead of original React19 prerelease; precise actual runtime package versions/scopes listed. No CopilotKit service SDK included.
Add original-host Chinese explanation, reset/simulation fixture controls, hidden/reduced-motion treatment and owned cleanup.
sourceDistribution: Seven public runtime/docs/license text assets only. Full original and adapted source/build/tests stay local; no nonexistent source archive claimed.
